title: Quiz Night on Wednesday 16 September
preheader: £3 cash entry · teams up to six · free-drink questions · spot prizes · food from 4pm

image.alt: Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.headline: Round up the team. Quiz Night is back.
body: Bring your smartest mate, your best guesser and the one who always knows the song intro. Our Autumn Kick-Off Quiz Night is packed with lively rounds, free-drink questions, spot prizes and plenty of friendly competition.

data.label: What to expect.
data.body: General knowledge · Music · TV and film · Pictures · Random facts · Free-drink questions

rows.label: Prizes
rows.value: £25 bar voucher for first place, plus free drinks and spot prizes

data.heading: A proper midweek quiz night
body: First-time teams are every bit as welcome as the regulars. Expect quick-fire moments, a phone mini challenge and a room full of teams ready to have a go.
Come down early for dinner and settle in before the first question. Our full dinner menu is available from 4pm to 9pm.

data.body: Book ahead for your team, then all you need to do is agree on a team name.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
